definitions.explanation: Characterized by being sensible, reliable, and avoiding unnecessary risks; down-to-earth and practical.

examples.japanese: {堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is trusted for his reliable character.

examples.japanese: {堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to solid management, the company survived the recession.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ - solid management
- {堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧ - reliable character
- {堅実|けんじつ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ - sensible lifestyle
- {堅実|けんじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ - to work steadily
- {堅実|けんじつ}さ - reliability (noun form)

POSITIVE CONNOTATION:
A complimentary term suggesting someone who is dependable, avoids risky behavior, and makes sound decisions.
